reviewer: visual hierarchy and layout; screenshot-only review, keyboard behavior and measured contrast were not assessed

issues.element: Initial viewport: KPI grid takes two tall rows, leaving only the upper plot fragment visible.
issues.fix: Use a compact short-desktop arrangement for KPI cards and their sparklines so a useful full trend plot appears on load; preserve the values and secondary text. A height-aware layout should be evaluated at these two exact viewports.

issues.element: Initial viewport: two tall card rows plus the explanatory notice push the actual token lines almost entirely below the bottom edge.
issues.fix: Reduce the pre-chart stack at short desktop heights: allow side-by-side values and short sparklines in the wider token cards, and put the detailed counter explanation behind a clearly labelled disclosure while keeping its essential warning visible.

issues.element: Token chart is technically introduced in the first viewport but its data is not visible.
issues.fix: Add a short-viewport layout that exposes the plot itself on load, then verify this with fold captures rather than full-height images.

issues.element: Filter bar: the compact search and Apply group ends far before Clear filters, leaving a large unused band and separating related filter actions.
issues.fix: Let the search field grow to a bounded useful width, such as 400–480px, and keep Clear filters beside Apply; Refresh can remain aligned to the far edge.

issues.element: Three violet series cross repeatedly in a roughly 270px plotting width; dotted and dashed series require sustained tracing despite correct legend keys.
issues.fix: Increase dash-pattern contrast and separation at the narrow breakpoint, such as fewer longer dashes for output and larger round dots for cache-read, while retaining the violet meaning and the full data.

issues.element: Counter-limitations notice is a dense five-line paragraph between cards and chart.
issues.fix: Lead with a short visible statement that counters overlap and cannot establish disjoint totals; place the detailed legacy qualifications in an adjacent disclosure without removing them.

issues.element: Two full-width, very tall charts stack vertically; the sparse TTFT chart occupies nearly as much area as the main duration chart.
issues.fix: Give the secondary TTFT chart a smaller bounded height on ultrawide windows, or arrange the two plots in a balanced two-column layout at that width. Keep all gaps and measurements.

issues.element: The long methodology paragraph precedes the first plot and competes with the performance data.
issues.fix: Keep the essential mixed-method TTFT caution visible, and group the detailed duration/speed caveats under a clearly labelled methodology disclosure.

issues.element: Request columns stretch across nearly the full ultrawide screen, creating large gaps between model identity, outcome, and token/cost numbers.
issues.fix: Bound the request table content width or define column sizing that gives extra width mainly to model identity instead of distributing it across every column.

issues.element: The model-rate row spreads its small set of values over almost the entire ultrawide content width.
issues.fix: Bound the table reading width or group the four price columns together with consistent compact spacing while retaining a generous model column.

issues.element: Model identity is regular weight in Requests but bold in Model Rates; row actions also use a bordered button versus a plain disclosure.
issues.fix: Use one deliberate model-name emphasis across the two tables. The different button/disclosure mechanics may stay, but align their text weight and spacing.

issues.element: Three full-width unavailable metric cards and two empty plots create a long scan with little measured content.
issues.fix: Use a more compact unavailable-card layout and retain the two chart messages/data-table entries without the tall repeated treatment.

issues.element: Loading panel uses a bare outline and centered text while empty/error states use a filled surface and a left-aligned status block.
issues.fix: Reuse the status-panel surface and alignment for loading, keeping its neutral status distinct from the error treatment.

regressions: At 3440px, compared with analytics-main, the search field is much narrower even though most of the filter row is unused; Clear filters is now visually detached from Apply. The compact header and larger trend plot otherwise improve the compared Overview/Tokens screens at 1440px, 3440px, and 390px. No observed loss of displayed data meaning in those comparisons.
